plate.narration: A sheltered ledge looks out across the glacier. On an upturned sled, a broad map waits beside loose sheets and a warm lantern. Beyond the shelter, the ice stretches blue and quiet.

goal.text: Compare your discoveries and help the travelers steady a new opening.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

npcVoices.Orin Vale: Methodical griffin scholar. Asks what a test actually showed.
npcVoices.Lady Olivia: Ambitious unicorn. Certain at first, surprised by limits, never punished for disagreeing.
npcVoices.Bram Lock: Protective bigfoot. Short practical requests, never orders the party.
npcVoices.Seren Wisp: Patient kitsune specialist. Distinguishes holding a condition from changing a rule.
npcVoices.Pip Thistledown: Eager manticore scout. His choice mirrors the party.

arrival.narration: At a sheltered glacier ledge, Orin waves you over to a map on an upturned sled. Olivia steadies one corner. Your Riftseeker friends make room for you. A bigfoot named Bram Lock keeps the path clear. "If an opening comes, help me keep everyone behind the line," he says. Orin pins the map with his boot. "Tonight we compare what you found," he says. "Then we steady any opening before people go near it."

accounts.narration: Orin makes room for your accounts. "Only what you really saw," he says. Seren Wisp, the kitsune teacher, sets down her chime. Pip catches a page with his tail and pretends he meant to. Which two places will you compare?

accounts_guided.narration: Hold the first page flat while Orin lays the other beside it. Name the edges you really saw. Leave the rest blank.

interaction.cue: Hold the pages apart for Orin.

onSuccess.narration: Orin labels only what you saw.

onFailure.narration: Orin labels only what you saw.

onAssisted.narration: Orin labels only what you saw.

compare_paths_coast.narration: Orin slides paper sheets over one another. Follow the sheet with the river copy from the memory readers. Your bridge drawing shows a different place today.

onSuccess.narration: You spot the marked copy and keep the two pages apart.

onFailure.narration: Orin lifts the sheets to show you.

onAssisted.narration: Orin lifts the sheets to show you.

compare_paths_sky.narration: Orin points to a river curve, a copied notch and a blank gap. Watch his four points, then copy them. Nobody draws a line to join them.

interaction.cue: Watch Orin point, then copy him.

onSuccess.narration: You can tell the copied marks from the blank gap.

onFailure.narration: Orin points again, slowly, and you follow along.

onAssisted.narration: Orin points again, slowly, and you follow along.

compare_coast_sky.narration: Slide the bridge drawing's edge next to the copied island carving while Orin holds them steady. Stop at the checked marks. The gap between stays blank.

onSuccess.narration: The two edges line up without stretching.

onFailure.narration: The page slips. Orin lines them up roughly.

onAssisted.narration: The page slips. Orin lines them up roughly.

measure.narration: The wind keeps lifting the sheets. Weigh them down with stones, and the felt-wrapped prop stays free for your lesson later. A string measure is more exact, but it needs that prop to pin its end.

measure_sheets.narration: Set smooth stones on the loose sheets. Orin moves his boot off the paper first. He is learning.

measure_line.narration: Guide the string to its mark while the felt-wrapped prop pins the far end. Nobody ties it around a traveler.

interaction.cue: Guide the string to its reference mark.

onFailure.narration: The string slips. Bram checks the rough span.

onAssisted.narration: The string slips. Bram checks the rough span.

evidence.narration: Orin labels the places you really visited, and the help you had along the way. He grins. "A very confident guess still gets a question mark."

variants.text: The memory readers showed you an old shape in the ice.
At the buried bridge, you matched an old river crossing to today's coast.
The island mooring stone showed an old boundary unlike the ground below it.

pull.narration: Snow grains slide toward the deep passage all by themselves. "Something is pulling," says Bram. "Can you steady my board while someone marks the grains?" Your Listening Chime can tell if a way back is open, but not where an opening goes. Pip moves his tail out of the way.

interaction.cue: Hold the board steady while the pull is marked.

onSuccess.narration: The grains point to the deep passage.

onFailure.narration: The grains point to the deep passage.

onAssisted.narration: The grains point to the deep passage.

clear_path.narration: You and Bram move loose benches behind the working line. There is room to turn back together. Orin rescues his notebook from under a bench leg. "Excellent support. Poor library."

signals.narration: Seren shows the safety signals: wait, shelter, wait. Watch, then copy them. Pip makes sure his wings do not hide her hand from the back.

interaction.cue: Watch the signals, then copy them.

onSuccess.narration: You can lead the signals yourselves.

rest.narration: Orin rolls up the map and opens the supper bag. You share dried apple rings and warm water. Pip pins a page down with an apple ring, then eats the paperweight.

proposal.narration: Olivia steps forward. "Let me call one small opening, right here by the pull." Orin wants more watching first. Bram keeps the way back clear. Olivia believes she can choose what she calls. What must happen before anyone goes near it?

summoning.narration: Olivia lifts her hand. An opening unfolds above the empty snow: wind, grit and a light she studies twice. She gestures again. It stops growing, but does nothing else she asks. The chime sounds sour. Bram reaches toward her hand. "Enough. Step back." Pip starts toward Olivia, then looks at you.

decision.narration: Bram turns to you. "Help me stop the experiment." Olivia shakes her head. "Stay beside me. I will stop feeding it and watch what it does." What will you do?

bram_plan.narration: You stand with Bram across the lane and leave Olivia room to step away. "Look at us, not the opening," he says. Pip stops behind the line. Olivia lowers her hand.

olivia_plan.narration: You stay beside Olivia on the marked ground. She stops her gesture, and you keep the way back clear. Pip follows, paws behind the mark. "We watch," Olivia says. "We do not cross." Bram waits at the shelter.

orin_plan.narration: Orin repeats the chime readings you shared at the buried bridge. "We learned something by waiting," he says. "Let this one answer first." Olivia hesitates, her hand still raised. Pip stays back with you.

bram_clear.narration: Pass the loose gear behind Bram's line while he walks Olivia back. Nobody grabs her or pushes her toward the opening.

interaction.cue: Pass the gear behind the line.

onSuccess.narration: Everyone and the gear are clear.

onFailure.narration: Everyone and the gear are clear.

onAssisted.narration: Everyone and the gear are clear.

variants.text: Your signals help Bram guide everyone back.
Bram leads the signals, and everyone follows him.

olivia_watch.narration: Olivia stops feeding the opening. From the working ground, mark the moment you see it clearly. Pip stays with you, and Bram holds the way back.

interaction.cue: Mark it when the view clears.

onFailure.narration: The view shrinks too fast. You leave it blank.

onAssisted.narration: The view shrinks too fast. You leave it blank.

steady_check.narration: A loose screen catches the wind. Hold it while Bram pins its edge from the safe lane. Olivia and Pip draw back with you.

interaction.cue: Hold the screen from the safe lane.

onSuccess.narration: Everyone is behind the safe line.

onFailure.narration: Everyone is behind the safe line.

onAssisted.narration: Everyone is behind the safe line.

orin_account.narration: Which reading will help Orin talk Olivia back? Remember, an opening does not have to obey anyone.

count.narration: A screen cord flaps, and the chime note wobbles. Seren holds the cord still, and the note changes. She lets it go, and the note changes back. "The cord," she says. "We will change that, and listen to the separate chime."

count_check.narration: Hold the screen cord still while the chime's note is written down. Seren's hook can help hold it too.

interaction.cue: Hold the cord while the note is written.

onSuccess.narration: The note is written down. Now let the cord go.

onFailure.narration: The note is written down. Now let the cord go.

onAssisted.narration: The note is written down. Now let the cord go.

cord_release.narration: From behind the line, let the cord go. Listen in the quiet moment between gusts.

interaction.cue: Release the screen cord and compare the note.

onSuccess.narration: The note wobbles again. Seren nods. "Holding the cord changed a condition, not the opening's rule."

onFailure.narration: A gust drowns the note. Seren will show you.

onAssisted.narration: A gust drowns the note. Seren will show you.

cord_help.narration: Pass the loose wind cover to Bram at the listening spot. Seren lets the cord go, and everyone hears the note wobble.

lesson.narration: Seren calls the lesson Manipulate. "You hold a condition that is already there," she says. "You never change an opening's rules." Practice by passing the padded grip along, or by balancing the felt prop on the cord's mark. If the prop still pins your string, fetch it first.

lesson_team.narration: Pass the padded grip along while the next helper takes the marked spot. Seren watches the cord. Nobody calls up a new opening.

interaction.cue: Pass the grip without losing the spot.

retrieve_prop.narration: Pass the felt prop back from the string board. Orin already wrote down your measurement, so the string can be packed.

lesson_prop.narration: Balance the felt-wrapped prop on the cord's mark while Seren listens to the note. Its tiny knitted cover keeps it from scratching the screen.

interaction.cue: Balance the prop on the mark.

lesson_attuned.narration: Your starweaver holds the condition with Seren while everyone watches the cord and listens. It does not move the opening or let anyone cross.

lesson_clear.narration: You have learned Manipulate: hold a condition still, and leave the opening's rules alone. Seren lets the cord go once everyone is behind the mark. The sour note returns.

account.narration: Orin opens his notebook for the next watcher. "Only checked results," he says. "Guesses stay questions." Olivia adds a sentence of her own: "I called an opening, but I did not choose its rules."

ending.narration: The travelers have heard your discoveries. The experiment is stopped, and you can hold a condition without changing a rule. The pull points down the deep passage. Time to follow the walking path.

variants.text: Olivia remembers you backed her at the whales and told her no here. "I will compare notes with Orin," she says. Pip stays by the safe mark.
Olivia remembers your help at the whales. "I can hold a condition too," she says. "If the ground starts moving, I will help hold it." Pip walks with her.
Olivia closes her notebook. "I still think we can do more," she says. She leaves by the open path, free to disagree.
The notebook says you tested the cord yourselves.
The cord test is credited to Seren.
Your glimpse after the summoning stays blank. Nobody fills it in with a guess.

finish.narration: Seren checks the shelter once more. The new opening stays marked for watchers. You carry the map down the walking passage, toward the heart of the glacier.

proposal_response_wait.narration: Bram moves the last loose gear back. Everyone has a way back.

proposal_response_stop.narration: Olivia agrees to stop before anyone crosses. Everyone has a way back.

proposal_response_watch.narration: Seren takes a clear view of the retreat lane. Everyone has a way back.

orin_account_response_wait.narration: Orin asks Olivia to let this opening answer first. She steps back with you.

orin_account_response_back.narration: Orin points to the walking route you already have. Olivia steps back with you.

orin_account_response_rules.narration: Olivia lowers her hand and listens. Then she steps back with you, and Bram lets out his breath.

account_response_cord.narration: Seren labels the changed condition. The page shows what changed.

account_response_lane.narration: Bram thickens the safe boundary line. The page shows what changed.

account_response_limit.narration: Orin puts a question beside the blank, then another beside Pip's confident doodle.
